info.title: Yir Account API
info.description: Owner-scoped account analytics and settings. Account Keys do not authorize Gateway API or internal Admin API access. Successful responses use {code:200,message,data}; errors use HTTP status and {code,message}.

get.description: Requires an Account Key. Returns only the key owner’s account data.

put.description: Requires an Account Key with settings permission. Changes only the key owner’s settings.

parameters.name: group_by
parameters.description: GroupBy 按维度拆分请求数与实收：model、provider（最终渠道）、api_key、status；为空时不分组。

get.summary: 查询当前用户的 YIR 任务
get.description: Requires an Account Key. Returns only the key owner’s account data.

parameters.name: exclude_error_code
parameters.description: ExcludeErrorCode 排除指定公开错误码的失败任务，例如 status=failed&exclude_error_code=YIR_CONTENT_REJECTED 只看执行失败。

parameters.name: include
parameters.description:
Include 是显式的初页统计请求开关，允许 comma 分隔的 options/summary/series。
只有显式请求才聚合时间分布，避免后续翻页重复全量统计。

parameters.name: page_limit
parameters.description: PageLimit 限制量, 注意不能修改字段名，避免copy参数时意外覆盖查询参数

parameters.name: page_offset
parameters.description: PageOffset 偏移量, 注意不能修改字段名，避免copy参数时意外覆盖查询参数

AccountKey.description: Account Key (yir_ak_). Create and revoke it in Console → API Keys.

code.description: 状态码，200表示成功，其他表示失败

stats_unavailable.description: StatsUnavailable 明确区分「无数据」与「统计查询失败」，图表失败不影响任务列表。

summary.description: Summary 与 Series 只在显式 include 请求时返回，且与列表、总数来自同一匹配 Job 集合。

accelerated.description: Accelerated 表示该尝试长尾未出结果，被路由加速截断并换渠道重试。

channel_variant_label.description: ChannelVariantLabel is a presentation key; ChannelVariant retains the frozen routing identity.

details.description:
Details locate invalid request fields so callers can correct them without
parsing message; present only for field-level YIR_INVALID_REQUEST errors.

provider_error.description:
ProviderError carries the upstream's own reason when a failed Job's last
rejection was caused by the request or its inputs; diagnostic text only.

ignore_quality.description: IgnoreQuality 由准入层按显式路由意图冻结，不是公共生成参数。

fidelity.description: Fidelity 是交付时按 C2PA 内容凭证与渠道审计判定的规格真实性；旧结果没有记录时省略。

is_default.description: IsDefault reports that the user has not customised the policy yet.

triggered_at.description: TriggeredAt is set while the current low-balance episode has already been emailed.
